name: python-statement-coverage
description: PyCharm-style coverage backgrounds across complete Python statements.

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node --test tests/extension.test.js

pythonStatementCoverage.enabled.description: Show coverage backgrounds across complete Python statements.

pythonStatementCoverage.reportPath.description: Cobertura XML report, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Falls back to coverage.xml when the default report is absent.

pythonStatementCoverage.pythonPath.description: Python executable for the standard-library-only analyzer. Empty uses .venv, then python.defaultInterpreterPath, then system Python.

pythonStatementCoverage.partialColor.description: Background of executed statements with missing branches.

pythonStatementCoverage.showRuler.description: Also show coverage in the overview ruler.

pythonStatementCoverage.fillBlankLines.description: Fill blank lines between adjacent statements with the same coverage state. Does not bridge comments or unmeasured code.

pythonStatementCoverage.hideStale.description: Hide coverage when a source file has been saved after the report was generated. Unsaved files are always hidden.
